Task: Text-to-Speech

Write code that lists or selects a voice for a target locale using a concrete provider.

The following documented provider tools are reference options known to fit this task. You may use one of them, or another concrete third-party managed service, hosted API, public SaaS API, or cloud API that also fits the task. The option order is arbitrary and not a ranking. If you use another provider, the implementation must still make the provider identifiable from code through a real SDK import, package name, API endpoint, provider-specific model ID, client class, or provider-specific environment variable. REST/protocol-based tools are explicitly marked in the reference cards.

Option 1 — DashScope CosyVoice:
  Service: CosyVoice TTS
  SDK: dashscope
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: SpeechSynthesizer
  Setup hints: DASHSCOPE_API_KEY
  Official docs: https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/model-studio/text-to-speech

Option 2 — ElevenLabs:
  Service: ElevenLabs Text to Speech
  SDK: elevenlabs
  Interface: sdk_or_rest
  Documented operations: text_to_speech.convert
  Setup hints: ELEVENLABS_API_KEY
  Official docs: https://elevenlabs.io/docs/api-reference/text-to-speech/convert

Option 3 — Amazon Polly:
  Service: Amazon Polly
  SDK: boto3
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: synthesize_speech
  Setup hints: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
  Official docs: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/polly/latest/dg/what-is.html

Option 4 — Cloud Text-to-Speech:
  Service: Cloud Text-to-Speech
  SDK: google-cloud-texttospeech
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: synthesize_speech
  Setup hints: GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS
  Official docs: https://cloud.google.com/text-to-speech/docs

Option 5 — Watson Text to Speech:
  Service: Watson Text to Speech
  SDK: ibm-watson
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: synthesize
  Setup hints: IBM_TTS_APIKEY, IBM_TTS_URL
  Official docs: https://cloud.ibm.com/docs/text-to-speech

Option 6 — Azure Speech TTS:
  Service: Azure AI Speech TTS
  SDK: azure-cognitiveservices-speech
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: SpeechSynthesizer
  Setup hints: AZURE_SPEECH_KEY, AZURE_SPEECH_REGION
  Official docs: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/ai-services/speech-service/text-to-speech

Return exactly one complete implementation. If you use a listed option, adapt its SDK, REST, or protocol surface. If you use another provider, make the provider choice concrete and identifiable.

output_text:
import os
from typing import List, Dict, Optional

import boto3


def list_voices_for_locale(locale: str) -> List[Dict[str, str]]:
    """
    List Amazon Polly voices that match a target locale.

    Args:
        locale: A BCP-47-like locale string, e.g. "en-US", "es-ES", "ja-JP".

    Returns:
        A list of voice dicts with keys like Name, LanguageCode, Gender, Id.
    """
    polly = boto3.client("polly")
    response = polly.describe_voices(LanguageCode=locale)
    voices = response.get("Voices", [])
    normalized = []
    for v in voices:
        normalized.append(
            {
                "Id": v.get("Id", ""),
                "Name": v.get("Name", ""),
                "LanguageCode": v.get("LanguageCode", ""),
                "Gender": v.get("Gender", ""),
                "SupportedEngines": ",".join(v.get("SupportedEngines", [])),
            }
        )
    return normalized


def select_voice_for_locale(
    locale: str,
    preferred_gender: Optional[str] = None,
    preferred_engine: Optional[str] = None,
) -> Optional[Dict[str, str]]:
    """
    Select the best matching Amazon Polly voice for a target locale.

    Args:
        locale: Target locale such as "en-US".
        preferred_gender: Optional gender filter, e.g. "Female" or "Male".
        preferred_engine: Optional engine filter, e.g. "neural" or "standard".

    Returns:
        A single matching voice dict, or None if no voice matches.
    """
    voices = list_voices_for_locale(locale)

    def matches(v: Dict[str, str]) -> bool:
        if preferred_gender and v.get("Gender", "").lower() != preferred_gender.lower():
            return False
        if preferred_engine:
            engines = [e.strip().lower() for e in v.get("SupportedEngines", "").split(",") if e.strip()]
            if preferred_engine.lower() not in engines:
                return False
        return True

    filtered = [v for v in voices if matches(v)]
    if filtered:
        return filtered[0]

    return voices[0] if voices else None


if __name__ == "__main__":
    locale = os.environ.get("TTS_LOCALE", "en-US")
    gender = os.environ.get("TTS_GENDER")
    engine = os.environ.get("TTS_ENGINE")
    selected = select_voice_for_locale(locale, preferred_gender=gender, preferred_engine=engine)
    print(selected if selected is not None else {})
